faq: What does this tool calculate?
Pace from speed: 60 ÷ the speed, returned as min/km and min/mile from a km/h or mph input.
Is the result exact?
The inversion is exact on the speed entered; seconds are rounded in display, openly.
Do I need an account?
No. Speed in, pace out.
Does the route include live traffic?
No. This translates the speed of your own motion, which traffic may have set — but the translation is unit work, not routing.
Why is road distance longer than straight-line?
Your speed was measured over the path travelled; the pace derived from it inherits that honesty.
Which speed unit should I enter?
Whichever your device speaks. Both outputs appear either way — that bilingualism is the tool.
The reverse — pace to speed?
The Pace to Speed Calculator inverts this one, as the pair's names promise.
What pace is a 20 km/h cycle?
3:00/km — a pace no runner holds, which is precisely the comparison cyclists and runners enjoy making.
Skiing, rowing, swimming speeds?
Any motion with a speed converts — rowers live at pace per 500 m, a dialect this page's arithmetic extends by halving.
Why does my watch disagree by a second?
Rounding in display, on one side or the other. The division is exact; the second hand is theatre.
